audience: field teams and operations managers who collect inspection and job data with Device Magic mobile forms

useCases.title: Read the submissions of a form
useCases.text: The AI lists the submitted data of one form with device, user, submitted_at and the answers. It sums up findings for a period. The form needs an active Device Magic Database destination.

useCases.title: Find devices waiting for approval
useCases.text: The AI lists devices with owner, group and whether approval is pending, and opens one device with its groups and custom attributes.

useCases.title: Check outstanding dispatches
useCases.text: The AI lists forms pushed to devices that are not yet completed, for the whole organization or one device, with the prefilled values of one dispatch.

useCases.title: Review groups, resources and form destinations
useCases.text: The AI lists groups, the lookup tables and files used by forms, and where a form's submissions are sent, such as email or database.

useCases.title: Send or revoke prefilled forms, or approve devices
useCases.text: The AI sends a form, prefilled with values like a site name, to one device, or withdraws an outstanding dispatch. It can also approve a pending device.
